Introduction

REST API for the Ready Booking platform — covering property listings, hotel bookings, technician marketplace, reviews, notifications, and admin operations.

Base URL: http://localhost

This documentation covers all endpoints for the Ready Booking API (v1).

All authenticated endpoints require a Bearer token obtained via POST /api/v1/auth/login. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer {token}.

Authenticating requests

To authenticate requests, include an Authorization header with the value "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}".

All authenticated endpoints are marked with a requires authentication badge in the documentation below.

Obtain a token via POST /api/v1/auth/login. Pass it as Authorization: Bearer {token}.

General

GET /api/v1/config/bootstrap

requires authentication

Single call that gives clients everything they need to configure themselves: site info, languages, currencies, active payment gateways (no secrets), feature toggles, limits, map provider public key, property types, and technician categories.

Response is cached for 5 minutes.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost/api/v1/config/bootstrap" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json"
const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/v1/config/bootstrap"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};


fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$url = 'http://localhost/api/v1/config/bootstrap';
$response = $client->get(
    $url,
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
    ]
);
$body = $response->getBody();
print_r(json_decode((string) $body));
Received response:
Request failed with error:

GET /api/v1/custom-fields?property_type=rent

requires authentication

Return active custom fields for a given property type. Used by listing forms to know which extra fields to render.

Example request:
curl --request GET \
    --get "http://localhost/api/v1/custom-fields" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"property_type\": \"architecto\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/v1/custom-fields"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "property_type": "architecto"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "GET",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$url = 'http://localhost/api/v1/custom-fields';

    $url,
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',

        ],
        'json' => [
            'property_type' => 'architecto',
        ],

);
$body = $response->getBody();

POST /api/v1/auth/register/start

requires authentication

Send registration OTP to phone. Returns 409 if phone already registered.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/register/start" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"phone\": \"bngzmiyvdljnikhw\",
    \"name\": \"a\",
    \"email\": \"breitenberg.gilbert@example.com\"
}"

const url = new URL(

const headers = {

    "Content-Type": "application/json",

POST /api/v1/auth/login

requires authentication

Two flows:

  1. Email + password → immediate token.
  2. Phone only → send OTP, return {otp_sent: true, otp: "..."}.
  3. Phone + otp → verify OTP, return token.
Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/login" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"phone\": \"bngzmiyvdljnikhw\",
    \"otp\": \"569775\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/login"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "phone": "bngzmiyvdljnikhw",
    "otp": "569775"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$url = 'http://localhost/api/v1/auth/login';
$response = $client->post(
    $url,
    [
        'headers' => [

);
$body = $response->getBody();

POST /api/v1/auth/social

requires authentication

Exchange a Google/Facebook token for a Sanctum token. Creates an account on first sign-in.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/social" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"provider\": \"google\",
    \"token\": \"b\"
}"

const url = new URL(
    "http://localhost/api/v1/auth/social"
);

const headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
};

let body = {
    "provider": "google",
    "token": "b"
};

fetch(url, {
    method: "POST",
    headers,
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
}).then(response => response.json());
$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();
$url = 'http://localhost/api/v1/auth/social';
$response = $client->post(
    $url,
    [
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
        ],
        'json' => [
            'provider' => 'google',
            'token' => 'b',
        ],
    ]

Idempotency: include X-Idempotency-Key header to make the request idempotent. Repeating with the same key durably returns the original booking response, even after a cache flush.

Race conditions: a distributed lock on (listing, check_in, check_out) prevents double-booking under concurrent requests.

Example request:
curl --request POST \
    "http://localhost/api/v1/bookings" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
    --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
    --header "Accept: application/json" \
    --data "{
    \"listing_id\": 16,
    \"check_in\": \"2052-08-06\",
    \"check_out\": \"2052-08-06\",
    \"guests\": 12,
    \"special_requests\": \"g\"
}"
